name: Wind Cloth Frame
description: WebGL photo or video printed on a paper-framed sheet that billows in a procedural wind, with ragged edges, film grain, scratches and orbit drag controls.
contents: Full-height WebGL canvas with a waving paper-framed image
Optional file upload button to swap in a local image or video
behavior: Plane vertices ripple with gusting wind, pinned at the top
Paper edge is ragged by noise, photo gets grain, dust and scratches
Drag to orbit the camera with damping
Uploaded videos play muted in a loop as the texture
editableByProps: Image URL, background and paper colors, upload button label and visibility
Wind strength, fabric ripple, shadow, edge roughness, grain, scratches and vignette
Camera distance, image size and orbit controls toggle

needsCodeEdit.change: Change wave shape of the billowing

fixed: Root is a full-width, viewport-height container that draws the canvas inside it
Listens to window resize while mounted and removes it on unmount
